description:
CHEERS TO THE GREAT OUTDOORS!

The Beer Mountain Brand:
Beer Mountain is the ultimate destination for beer enthusiasts who love adventure! Our brand is dedicated to providing top-quality products that enhance your outdoor experiences. We're excited to introduce our flagship product, the AD25 Adventure Series Cooler Backpack, which is the perfect blend of functionality and fun, designed for those who enjoy the great outdoors and appreciate a cold beer along the way.

Product Description:
The AD25 Adventure Series Cooler Backpack is a revolutionary solution for hikers, campers, and outdoor enthusiasts. This premium hiking backpack isthe ONLY daypack on the market equipped with a fully insulated cooler compartment designed to keep your favorite beverages, including beer, refreshingly cold during your adventures. It offers a spacious main compartment, multiple pockets for organization, and comfortable shoulder straps, making it the ideal companion for any excursion. With the AD25, you can enjoy your favorite brews while embracing the beauty of nature.

USP (Unique Selling Point):
Our AD25 Adventure Series Cooler Backpack stands out with its unique selling points:


Fully Insulated Cooler: Keep your beer and beverages cold while exploring the great outdoors.

  1. Premium Quality: Crafted with durable materials for long-lasting use.
  2. Comfortable Design: Padded shoulder straps and ergonomic back support for a comfortable journey.
  3. Versatility: Suitable for hiking, camping, picnics, and all your outdoor activities.
  4. Adventure-Ready: Designed to enhance your outdoor adventures and make them even more enjoyable.

Payment Terms:
As an affiliate of Beer Mountain, you'll enjoy generous commission rates. Affiliates receive a competitive 15% commission on total referral sales when customers make a purchase through your affiliate link or use your unique coupon code. Payouts are made monthly, and the minimum payout threshold is $50 USD.

Other Information:

  1. We provide our affiliates with a range of promotional materials and resources to help you succeed in promoting the AD25 Adventure Series Cooler Backpack.
  2. We are dedicated to supporting our affiliates and are open to discussing personalized terms for high-performing partners.
  3. If you have any questions or require additional information, please feel free to contact our affiliate support team at cheers@beermountainlife.com.
  4. Join Beer Mountain's affiliate program today and start sharing the joy of cold beer in the great outdoors while earning competitive commissions!

Cheers to an adventurous partnership with Beer Mountain!

Welcome to Beer Mountain Affiliate Program (the "Program"). We are absolutely thrilled to have you on board. Let's get some quick terms and conditions out of the way before the real fun begins.

By participating in our Program, you agree to these Terms and Conditions (the "Terms"). Please read these Terms carefully before becoming an affiliate. If you do not agree with these Terms, please do not join our Program.

1. Affiliate Commission

1.1. As an affiliate of Beer Mountain, you will earn a commission of 15% on the total sales made through your unique affiliate link or coupon code.

1.2. Commissions are calculated based on the total purchase amount before taxes, shipping, and any applied discounts.

2. Payouts

2.1. Payouts to affiliates are typically made on a monthly basis.

2.2. Payouts will be issued via paypal and/or bank transfer to the payment information provided by the affiliate.

2.3. The minimum payout threshold is $50. If your earned commission is below this threshold, the amount will be carried over to the next payout cycle.

3.1. You are responsible for promoting Beer Mountain's products and services using the materials and affiliate resources provided.

3.2. You must not engage in any unlawful, unethical, or fraudulent activities when promoting our products or services.

3.3. You must adhere to all applicable laws and regulations while promoting our products and services.

4.1. These Terms become effective upon your acceptance and will remain in effect until terminated by either party with a 30-day written notice.

4.2. Beer Mountain reserves the right to terminate this agreement immediately without notice if you violate any of these Terms.

5. Modifications

5.1. Beer Mountain reserves the right to modify these Terms at any time. Notice of changes will be provided via email or within our affiliate portal.

5.2. It is your responsibility to review these Terms regularly to ensure compliance with the latest terms and conditions.

6. Confidentiality

6.1. You agree to keep all non-public information, including customer data, confidential and not disclose such information to third parties.

7. Dispute Resolution

7.1. Any disputes related to these Terms will be resolved through negotiations and, if necessary, through binding arbitration.

8. Miscellaneous

8.1. These Terms represent the entire understanding between you and Beer Mountain regarding the Program and supersede any prior agreements.

8.2. These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of California.

By participating in our Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms and Conditions.

Now that that’s out of the way, let’s have some fun and make some money! Cheers!

-The Beer Mountain Team
